card.name: Final piece of combination drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long drug name, often in a combination product with 'and' (e.g. the 'ide' of Methylbromide, 'x' of Polistirex, 'fen' of Ibuprofen). It fires mainly in hydrocodone and antihistamine product names.

modes.label: Salt ending of hydrocodone combos
modes.description: The closing piece of a name such as Methylbromide or Polistirex, just before a dosage form or the next drug.
modes.example: Hydrocodone Bitartrate and Homatropine Methylbrom<<ide>> Oral Solution (Syrup), may

modes.label: Inside other drug names
modes.description: A piece partway through or at the end of another drug name, such as ibuprofen, amitriptyline or pseudoephedrine.
modes.example: Hydrocodone Bitartrate and Ibupro<<fen>> Tablets in patients with acute or severe bron
